entries.zh: 送；赠送、送给（呈上礼物）
entries.en: to give, to present (a gift); to make a present

entries.zh: 饷；供食、给饭食（奉上食物）
entries.en: to present food; to serve or give food, provisions

entries.zh: 钱礼；赠送钱财（致送钱礼）
entries.en: a present of money; to give money as a gift
entries.notes: H「拆」与「presente de dinero」不合，M 之 chiê/tiâ/chŷ 无从对定，R「salir a recebir」疑为旁注，存疑。

entries.zh: 饯；饯行（送行所赠的酒食、礼物）
entries.en: a farewell feast or gift for the road; send-off present

entries.zh: 馈；馈赠（赠送食物、盘缠等物）
entries.en: to present provisions as a gift; parting gift of food for the road

entries.zh: 迓；出迎、迎候（到路头迎接来客）
entries.en: to go out to meet and welcome someone on the road
entries.notes: H「迓」为出迎、迎神之礼，L 作「路途之礼」，义近而未尽合。

entries.zh: 办礼（备办礼物、行礼致贺）
entries.en: to prepare and present ceremonial gifts; to bring congratulations with a present
entries.notes: H 栏作「辨礼」，M pan-lé 当为「办礼」，据西语 dar el parabién（道贺）定之。

entries.zh: 表里（成套衣料：袍面与里料，用作赠礼）
entries.en: a present of cloth pieces, outer cloth with its lining; a gift of silk lengths

entries.zh: 薄礼（微薄的礼物，谦称）
entries.en: a small present; a humble, modest gift
entries.notes: H「洦礼」即「薄礼」，M poh-lé 可证。

entries.zh: 搬请（捧持礼物登门相请、送致）
entries.en: to carry a present in the hands and bring it to someone; a hand-carried gift
entries.notes: M 首音节 T99 污损难辨，H「搬请」之义依 L 与闽南语 poa-chhiáⁿ 推补。

entries.zh: 敬奉（恭敬地奉上、呈献）
entries.en: to present with respect; to offer reverently

entries.zh: 敬贺（恭敬道贺，奉上贺礼）；贺仪
entries.en: to congratulate respectfully with a present; a congratulatory gift
entries.notes: M 中段有「[残]」，赖 H「敬贺」及次词「贺仪」(ho-gi) 互补。

entries.zh: 祭礼（祭祀亡者、丧葬所备之礼）
entries.en: offerings and rites for the dead; a funeral gift

entries.zh: 生日（生日当天送礼致贺、祝寿）
entries.en: birthday; to present gifts on a birthday

entries.zh: 迊送（以双手捧送、奉上）
entries.en: to present with both hands; to hand over a gift with both hands
entries.notes: H 首字「迊」罕见，M tep 对应不明，仅「双手奉送」义可定。

entries.zh: 纳卷（向考官呈交试卷）
entries.en: to hand in one's paper or scroll to the mandarin; to submit an examination essay
entries.notes: L「su retorica」疑有脱漏（指官话文章），H「纳卷」与 M lap-kùi 相合。

entries.zh: 庆寿（为尊长祝寿、贺寿送礼）
entries.en: to celebrate a birthday with presents, esp. for a superior such as the bishop

entries.zh: 送表里（赠送衣料绸缎等非食用之礼）
entries.en: to send a present of cloth, outer garment and lining; non-food gifts

entries.zh: 下程（送行时馈赠的食物、路菜）
entries.en: farewell food gifts; provisions given to a departing guest

entries.zh: 送路费（赠送盘缠、旅费）
entries.en: to give travel money; a present of travelling expenses
entries.notes: L 介词处有「[疑:ael/adl]」，仅关冠词，不影响「送路费」之义。

entries.zh: 送钱盒（馈送盛放点心果品的盒盘）
entries.en: to send a tray or box of sweets and delicacies (bandeja de colación)
entries.notes: H「钱盒」与 L「bandeja de colación」（点心果盒）不密合，M 末字已残，姑就盒礼之义释之。
